standard_prerequisites.use: In the final Noetherian n-torsion case it provides constructibility of the sheaves R^if_*F, the input to the specialization and characterization lemmas.

standard_prerequisites.name: Locally constant sheaves as a colimit (Etale Cohomology, Lemma etale-cohomology-lemma-category-loc-cst-is-colimit, canonical tag 0GL2)
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the locally constant sheaf F descend to a finite type locally constant F_i on some X_i in the Noetherian descent.

standard_prerequisites.name: Locally constant characterization (Etale Cohomology, Lemma etale-cohomology-lemma-characterize-locally-constant-module, canonical tag 0GKC)
standard_prerequisites.use: The terminal criterion: constructible sheaves whose specialization maps are isomorphisms are locally constant.

core_obligations: Make the torsion degree uniform: work locally on S, define the pointwise annihilator n_x, use a finite etale trivializing cover to see it is locally constant with finitely many values, decompose X into open and closed pieces by torsion degree, and reduce to a single n prime to all residue characteristics (proof lines 5015-5030).
Replace S by the image: f(X) is open and closed since f is smooth and proper, so assume f is surjective and n is invertible on S (proof lines 5033-5036).

Descend to the Noetherian case: write A as a union of finite type Z[1/n]-subalgebras, descend f to a finitely presented f_i and improve it to smooth proper by the Limits lemmas, descend F to a finite type locally constant F_i by the colimit lemma, and replace F_i by Ker(n : F_i -> F_i) to make it n-torsion (proof lines 5039-5059).

Conclude in the Noetherian case: constructibility of R^if_*F from theorem-constructible-shriek, isomorphic specialization maps from the proper torsion locally acyclic lemma, and the locally constant characterization (proof lines 5062-5070).
proof_roadmap: Uniform torsion degree via locally constant annihilators (proof lines 5015-5030).
Image replacement and invertibility of n on S (proof lines 5033-5036).
Constructibility plus specialization isomorphisms give local constancy (proof lines 5062-5070).
